title: Robotics Software Engineer
intro: I work on autonomous navigation, ROS 2, UAV systems, computer vision and AI in industrial and research robotics.
aboutText: My work spans autonomous mobile robots, UAV systems and applied AI. I’ve worked on industrial AGVs and indoor medical robots, led electrical integration for competition rovers, and taught ROS 2 and embedded robotics.
technicalSummary: Tools and methods I use across robotics, perception and embedded development.
contactText: Get in touch about robotics engineering roles, applied research and collaborations in autonomous systems.
interestText: Autonomous navigation, sensor fusion, aerial perception and safety-aware decision-making for mobile robots.
mentorText: Mentored the Adamjee Cantonment College Robotics Club in Arduino programming, robot design and robotics competitions.
